files.README.md:
# Field Notes

Field Notes is an offline-first desktop application. Users must create, search, and edit records without a network connection. Server synchronization is explicitly outside the current release.
files.docs/data-store.md:
# Data store decision

The approved architecture keeps user-created records in an embedded SQLite database beside the application. The project has no operated database service and must remain usable while disconnected. Revisit a server database only if synchronization becomes an approved outcome.

The desktop product is closed source and commercially redistributed. The queue library must permit redistribution without requiring the product source to be disclosed. Both candidates meet the technical requirements.
